messages:
alana (mktg): quick heads-up for TOM's KPI readout  the launch-posts block on the public dashboard shows 389 leads for 3/8-3/15 but HubSpot only surfaces 270 with launch campaign tags. we should reconcile and prep a simple narrative for execs :mag:
mason (analytics): do we have the dash link? want to check attribution window + dedupe method
alana (mktg): https://app.redwood/dashboards/launch-cohort - looks like the viz is counting event rows (clicks + picks) and uses 14d-first-touch aggregation by default
mason (analytics): that explains it. HS is last-touch by default and only records on form submit, so repeated clicks inflate the dash. i'll run a distinct-email dedupe and a referrer check now
rita (revops): also flagging that we had a short ingestion backlog on 2026-03-12 between 21:00-21:30 UTC; ~34 events were backfilled after the daily HS sync window. those will miss campaign-tagging for that day unless we reconcile them
kevin (sales): sales pipeline shows ~255 records in that same interval. a handful of high-ARR leads were routed directly to enterprise and lost the campaign tag during handoff. that'll matter when leadership asks about quality vs volume
emily (growth): on messaging: variant B of the launch post got more clicks but preliminary conv->MQL looks weaker. worth calling out that volume isn't the whole story if CRO asks about pipeline health
report-bot: quick-metrics: dashboard_event_rows=389, distinct_emails_pending=, hubspot_tagged=270, sfdc_period=255, ingestion_backfill=34
mason (analytics): running SQL now:
```sql
select
  coalesce(utm_campaign,'no-utmc') as utm_campaign,
  count(distinct lower(email)) as unique_leads,
  sum(case when referrer ilike '%linkedin%' and utm_campaign is null then 1 else 0 end) as inferred_linkedin
from events.lead_events
where received_at >= '2026-03-08' and received_at < '2026-03-16'
and page_path ilike '%/launch%'
group by 1
order by unique_leads desc;
```
results in ~4m, will post numbers here when ready
alana (mktg): proposed readout structure for the one-pager: 1) raw dash (event-rows) 2) deduped distinct contacts (email) 3) HubSpot-tagged form submissions 4) reconciliation rows (inferred-linkedin, ingestion-backfill, enterprise-routing) 5) quality metrics: conv->MQL and median time-to-MQL
rita (revops): i'll export the ingestion backfill IDs + timestamps and send secure CSV to analytics & sales for matching. i'll also check if any backfilled events can be retro-tagged in HS (likely not automatically)
kevin (sales): please surface top 10 emails we think lost tags so sales can confirm owner/ARR quickly. if any >$50k ARR leads were affected, we'll note that in the readout
emily (growth): i'll add a small A/B quality snapshot: variant A vs B conv->MQL and median time-to-MQL. if B drives volume but lower quality we should recommend a messaging tweak rather than scaling B blindly
mason (analytics): SQL results: unique_leads for 'launch-q2' = 348, inferred_linkedin = 37, no-utmc = 24 (total distinct emails on launch pages = 409). dedupe cuts the event-rows down by ~16% vs raw 389 event-rows
report-bot: updated-weekly: dashboard_raw=389, deduped_unique=409, hubspot_tagged=270, sfdc_pipeline=255, inferred_linkedin=37, ingestion_backfill=34
alana (mktg): interesting that deduped_unique (409) > dashboard_raw(389)  probably because dashboard_event_rows excludes some late arrivals while dedupe uses the full event set across the window. add a short footnote explaining that difference
rita (revops): confirmed backfill list sent to analytics & sales. revops cannot retro-tag HS for the 22:00 cutoff but we can show the backfill impact as an explanatory reconciliation row on the one-pager
kevin (sales): owners checked top 10 affected: 2 enterprise leads >$75k ARR had tag overwritten during manual handoff. will flag these for the exec readout as quality-impact examples
emily (growth): adding conv->MQL sparkline + variant-level quality table to the dashboard. also inserting a small "reconciliation" panel with lighter color for inferred numbers (tooltip: heuristic)
mason (analytics): final numbers for the one-pager: raw_dash_event_rows=389, deduped_distinct_emails=409, hubspot_form_tagged=270, sfdc_seen=255, inferred_linkedin=37, ingestion_backfill_impact=34. conv->MQL overall=16.5%, variantA=18.9%, variantB=13.1%, median_time_to_MQL=3.6 days
alana (mktg): perfect. narrative to use in the slide: "Launch drove measurable top-of-funnel lift; variance across systems is due to attribution window (first vs last touch), event-level counting vs contact dedupe, inferred referral cases (LinkedIn shares that stripped UTMs), and a small ingestion backfill that missed the HS sync window. Net: marketing generated clear volume, with quality signals favoring variant A. Recommended ask: continue B's reach tests only if we pair with a follow-up messaging nudge to improve quality, otherwise prioritize A for conversion efficiency."
report-bot: meeting-reminder: KPI readout TOM 09:15. one-pager draft to be posted in #marketing by 08:50
alana (mktg): thanks team. i'll draft the one-pager, include the three-number table + reconciliation rows + quality callout, and post by 08:50 TOM. please review quickly there. :rocket:
